meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类操作后,comment-checker 若发出警告,Codex 会收到阻塞反馈,需先修正或解释被标记的注释才能继续。
howto.when: 在 Codex 成功调用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具之后,comment-checker 报出警告时接管;非编辑类工具被该插件忽略。

say.text: comment-checker 警告的那条注释,帮我改掉
say.note: 我会先修正被标记的注释

say.text: 解释一下这条被标记的注释为什么需要保留
say.note: 说明理由后再继续下一步

say.text: 看看我上次的编辑有没有触发 comment-checker 警告
say.note: 我会检查该次补丁的反馈

howto.what_en: After a successful edit (apply_patch, write, edit and similar), if comment-checker warns, Codex receives blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggers after Codex successfully runs edit-like tools such as apply_patch, write or edit, when comment-checker reports a warning. Non-edit tools are ignored.

say_en.text: Fix the comment that comment-checker flagged
say_en.note: I'll correct the flagged comment first

say_en.text: Explain why that flagged comment should stay
say_en.note: I'll give the reason, then continue

say_en.text: Check if my last edit triggered a comment-checker warning
